# ReasoningReceipt

> Portable, byte-verifiable receipts for AI decisions and actions. Capture evidence, policy checks, tool calls, approvals, and outcomes as independently provable Merkle nodes.

ReasoningReceipt is a domain-neutral protocol layer between an AI system and the world it affects. Each typed evidence node gets its own SHA-256 and one Merkle root commits the complete receipt. Receipts are canonical JSON and verify offline without trusting a model provider, chain, storage service, or ReasoningReceipt server. Arc anchoring, Irys storage, and x402 payment are optional adapters. The original Polymarket/Kalshi oracle remains as a reference implementation and historical dataset.

## Portable API

- Create: `POST /v1/receipts` with a subject, metadata, and 1–128 typed evidence nodes.
- Verify: `POST /v1/verify` recomputes every commitment locally.
- Selective proof: `POST /v1/proofs` returns a Merkle inclusion proof for one node.

## Production deployment

- The dashboard and API run on Vercel; durable receipt data lives in Neon Postgres.
- Vercel Cron invokes bounded agent batches, and the dashboard polls serverless endpoints instead of requiring a persistent SSE process.
- Historical receipts remain available in the live dashboard and on Arc Testnet.

## Docs

- [Repository](https://github.com/tang-vu/reasoning-receipt): protocol, API, dashboard, tests, and reference adapters.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/tang-vu/reasoning-receipt/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): receipt pipeline, schemas, and contracts.
- [MCP integration](https://github.com/tang-vu/reasoning-receipt/blob/main/docs/mcp.md): legacy oracle tools for MCP clients.

- ReceiptRegistryV2: `0x27d93c52fea923f956345af27f61d7bf47f0c4c1`
- Chain id: `5042002` (Arc Testnet)
- Product: https://rrtrace.xyz
- API: https://reasoning-receipt-api.vercel.app
